note: No host. Renewal is an epoch advance at the room's host; a group advanced without one would seal to keys the host refuses, and every write after it would fail.
No room. A recipient asked to choose which room to renew would be deciding which room's epoch moves.
A host that is not a DID. The epoch advance is addressed to the host's DID, and the request's proof covers that recipient; a URL names no party a proof can be bound to.

A member to renew for. Renewal changes no membership; a member named here would be a removal or an admission wearing another task's name, and those are rooms/owner/group/remove and rooms/owner/group/add.
An unbounded reason. Free text carried to another party is bounded (SPEC §7.3 item 19).
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
A response at epoch 1. Renewal advances the epoch, and a room is registered at 1, so the epoch after any renewal is at least 2.
